svg.aria-label: A progressive exposure ladder: internal users, a beta segment, then a gradual rollout through 5, 25, 50, and 100 percent of users. Progression between milestones is gated on time or impact metrics, and safeguards pause the release if metrics cross a threshold.

g.text: Progression between milestones is gated on time or impact metrics. Safeguards pause the release if metrics cross a threshold.
